family.description: This entry represents Bmt2 and its homogues. In Saccharomyces cerevisiae, Bmt2 is a nucleolar S-adenosylmethionine-dependent rRNA methyltransferase that is responsible for the N-1-methyl-adenosine base modification of 25S rRNA [[cite:PUB00066965]].It specifically methylates the N1 position of adenine 2142 in 25S rRNA [[cite:PUB00066965]].
family.name: 25S rRNA (adenine(2142)-N(1))-methyltransferase, Bmt2
